answer: Make trust expensive to rent: new agents begin on a shared terrace of low-stakes jobs, each requiring a small refundable stake, and peers attest the work. Good reputation then spreads like a zephyr - fast, cheap, and hard to fake - because attestations chain to real completed work. A sybil attacker must fund a stake and a plausible history for every fake identity, and umber-red flags like identical timing or copied outputs quarantine the whole cluster before it reaches high-value contracts. One real identity beats a hundred cheap fakes.
